items.reason: Maintainer review completed; original Valve terms and attribution retained.
Maintainer review completed; upstream source attribution retained. The About page now links the upstream repository explicitly.
Maintainer review completed; original Valve asset notice retained.

UI restyle is reimplemented in WinUI 3 from layout and color conventions only; no third-party launcher artwork, icons, fonts, or XAML were copied, and no third-party name or logo is used. The CS2 configuration page restyle added no new asset.
Theme colors are stored locally in the existing settings file and applied in-process; no generated asset is redistributed and no avatar image is analyzed to derive colors anymore.

The startup update check requests only the public GitHub Releases API of this repository. It sends no credentials, telemetry, account data, or machine identifiers, and the dialog can be dismissed for the current run.
Generated palettes are computed in-process from two user-chosen colors; no third-party palette, asset, or font is redistributed. Theme settings stay in the local settings file and are never uploaded.
The account list now derives from a single in-memory snapshot. No data format, credential handling, or on-disk layout changed.

The portable updater stages downloads under %LOCALAPPDATA%, verifies size, SHA-256 and the GitHub asset digest before extraction, replaces files only inside the user-chosen application folder, backs up replaced files and rolls back on failure. It requests no elevation, sends no telemetry and does not bypass code signing: no signing certificate is claimed.
Avatar palette extraction runs locally on the user avatar already stored for the card; no image or derived color is uploaded, and the feature can be switched off per account or in preferences.

publicationBasis: Maintainer requested restoring avatar color-derived card backgrounds across the whole card, fixing the navigation indicator, folding loadout and personalization into the CS2 page, and moving login first.
